title: Golfclub Kitzbühel-Schwarzsee-Reith
highlights: Renowned 18-hole golf course located right next to the moorland lake Schwarzsee
Fascinating panoramic vistas across the rugged limestone crest of the Wilder Kaiser
Varied course architecture featuring strategically placed water hazards
State-of-the-art golf academy equipped with a spacious driving range
kurzbeschreibung: Golfclub Kitzbühel-Schwarzsee-Reith offers an outstanding 18-hole course with panoramic views of the Wilder Kaiser.
beschreibung:
Golfing in the Heart of the Kitzbühel Mountains

Golfclub Kitzbühel-Schwarzsee-Reith is considered one of Austria's most scenic and varied golf courses. Nestled among the rolling hills between Kitzbühel and Reith, it rewards players on almost every fairway with breathtaking views of the Wilder Kaiser and the Kitzbüheler Horn.

Sporting Challenge and Scenic Grandeur

The 18-hole par-72 course features an ingenious layout: while the front nine traverse flat meadowlands, the back nine demand precise course management with undulating fairways and strategic water hazards. The legendary 16th hole—the mousetrap across a wooded ravine—challenges even the most seasoned golfers.
